development_source: Sharapova examined before rules; not independent accuracy evidence
rules: Ordinary nearest-box geometry and existing candidate support/650ms horizons remain intact. No forearm rule globally switches or removes ordinary motion proposals.

Boxes with >=3 mixed eye+ear points inside, or both ears inside with all five head points available, and both wrists outside retain weak motion-proximity support but cannot independently confirm primary grip. These are semantic ambiguities, not confirmed false detections.

Alternative wrist requires earlier opposite-wrist head ambiguity within 650ms before its own geometric peak, two distinct later source frames with unique elbow-to-wrist forward ray/box support inside its original valid sweep window, and continuous identity/camera/source binding. No modified threshold, score, review label, name or model speed comparison chooses the wrist.

A separate alternative proposal must pass unchanged preparation/acceleration/follow-through rules with its measured peak inside that geometry window before NMS can favor it. Incomplete alternatives cannot shorten the original proposal window.
NMS legacy proximity ordering is separate from reported independent grip evidence; ordinary arm choice does not silently flip when uncertainty downgrades hand confidence.
Candidate-window object counts and reported-phase object counts/provenance are separate. No later-frame reacquisition support route was retained.
remaining_case: Ordinary B left motion unchanged; no manual right side or native swap inferred.
